en-US.description: A local-first AI workspace for multi-agent chat, coding, and visual workflows.
en-US.longDescription: A local-first AI workspace for multi-agent chat, coding, and visual workflows. Available as a desktop app and self-hosted web console, with support for Hermes Agent, Ekko Agent, and 14 coding-agent integrations, including Claude Code and Codex. Bring conversations, group collaboration, voice, files, and devices together in one place.

zh-CN.description: 本地优先的 AI 工作区，支持多 Agent 聊天、编码和可视化工作流。
zh-CN.longDescription: 本地优先的 AI 工作区，支持多 Agent 聊天、编码和可视化工作流。提供桌面应用和可自托管的 Web 控制台，支持 Hermes Agent、Ekko Agent，以及包含 Claude Code、Codex 在内的 14 种 Coding Agent 集成。在同一个工作区中管理对话、群组协作、语音、文件和设备。
zh-CN.name: Ekko Studio
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
更新重点
- 新建聊天改为响应式页面，使用 Agent 卡片选择助手，并复用聊天输入框与会话设置 (#3333)
- 新建聊天记住上次使用的模型、工作目录、启动方式和推理选项，方便连续创建会话 (#3333)
- Agent 卡片新增金色边框与玉色流光，并统一各平台卡片内部动画的速度 (#3336、#3344)
- 修复 Agent 卡片循环切换时的缩放跳变，以及鼠标在列表外释放后仍会拖动的问题 (#3335、#3340)
- 修复长数字、符号或空白文本导致 Token 计算卡顿、聊天无响应的问题 (#3325)
- 完善上下文用量估算与自动压缩，计入工具调用和模型实际用量，修复工具组跨压缩边界时无法压缩的问题 (#3329)
- 修复编程 Agent 因依赖输出调试日志而中断聊天的问题，提高 DSH 和其他 ACP Agent 的兼容性 (#3327)
- 修复不同 Hermes 内核版本下澄清问题与回答回调的兼容性问题 (#3330)
- 手机网页端侧边栏与 App 保持一致，宽度采用屏幕的 90%、最大 380px，改善较宽屏幕上的显示 (#3346)
- Studio 与桌面端版本同步更新为 0.7.33，前端更新日志补齐 11 种语言并保留最近三个版本 (#3345)
What's Changed
- fix(tokens): guard quadratic BPE for digit/symbol/whitespace runs by @WenhuaXia in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3325
- fix Hermes clarify callbacks across kernel versions by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3330
- [codex] replace new-chat drawer with responsive Agent cards by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3333
- [codex] fix Agent card scaling at click loop boundaries by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3335
- [codex] add gold and jade foil to Agent cards by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3336
- fix(coding-agents): tolerate dependency stdout noise on ACP pipes by @WenhuaXia in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3327
- fix(chat-run): count tool_calls and real usage in bridge context estimate by @chloeassistant in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3329
- [codex] stop Agent cards dragging after mouse release outside the list by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3340
- [codex] keep new-chat card interior animations at a consistent speed by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3344
- chore: prepare Studio 0.7.33 with localized changelog by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3345
- [codex] match mobile sidebar width to App by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3346
New Contributors
- @chloeassistant made their first contribution in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3329
Full Changelog: https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/compare/v0.7.32...v0.7.33
